Synopsis:
Article covers the peak of the 2026 Perseid meteor shower (Aug 12–13), coinciding with a New Moon and a total solar eclipse over parts of Europe. Content is primarily astronomical and observational, with brief mention of summer thunderstorm activity potentially obscuring views and a heat dome over Europe referenced tangentially in related posts. No substantive energy or power market content.
